changes.name: GrowIslandGame
changes.source:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("GrowTheIsland_v1")
local world = workspace:FindFirstChild("GrowIslandWorld")
if world then world:Destroy() end
world = Instance.new("Folder")
world.Name = "GrowIslandWorld"
world.Parent = workspace

local function makePart(name,size,pos,color,material,parent)
	local p=Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name=name
	p.Size=size
	p.Position=pos
	p.Anchored=true
	p.Color=color
	p.Material=material
	p.Parent=parent or world
	return p
end

-- Remove the default baseplate so the floating-island idea reads clearly.
local base=workspace:FindFirstChild("Baseplate")
if base then base:Destroy() end

local island=makePart("StarterIsland",Vector3.new(54,4,54),Vector3.new(0,18,0),Color3.fromRGB(82,142,70),Enum.Material.Grass)
local earth=makePart("IslandEarth",Vector3.new(50,7,50),Vector3.new(0,12.5,0),Color3.fromRGB(95,68,48),Enum.Material.Ground)
local spawn=Instance.new("SpawnLocation")
spawn.Name="IslandSpawn"
spawn.Size=Vector3.new(7,1,7)
spawn.Position=Vector3.new(0,21,15)
spawn.Anchored=true
spawn.Neutral=true
spawn.Transparency=0.35
spawn.Parent=world

local core=makePart("EnergyCore",Vector3.new(7,7,7),Vector3.new(0,24,0),Color3.fromRGB(90,180,255),Enum.Material.Neon)
core.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball
local light=Instance.new("PointLight")
light.Brightness=2
light.Range=22
light.Parent=core

local prompt=Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.ActionText="Grow Island"
prompt.ObjectText="Energy Core"
prompt.HoldDuration=0.35
prompt.MaxActivationDistance=12
prompt.Parent=core

local stages={}
local function hiddenPart(name,size,pos,color,material)
	local p=makePart(name,size,pos,color,material)
	p.Transparency=1
	p.CanCollide=false
	table.insert(stages,p)
	return p
end

hiddenPart("Expansion1",Vector3.new(34,3,28),Vector3.new(38,18.5,0),Color3.fromRGB(82,142,70),Enum.Material.Grass)
hiddenPart("Expansion2",Vector3.new(30,3,30),Vector3.new(-38,18.5,-8),Color3.fromRGB(75,132,65),Enum.Material.Grass)
hiddenPart("Bridge",Vector3.new(45,2,9),Vector3.new(0,18,49),Color3.fromRGB(118,86,56),Enum.Material.WoodPlanks)
hiddenPart("TreasureIsland",Vector3.new(34,4,34),Vector3.new(0,18,78),Color3.fromRGB(72,126,62),Enum.Material.Grass)

local costs={10,30,70,140}

local function showStage(stage)
	local p=stages[stage]
	if p then
		p.Transparency=0
		p.CanCollide=true
	end
end

local function refreshPrompt(player)
	local stats=player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local stage=player:FindFirstChild("IslandStage")
	if not stats or not stage then return end
	if stage.Value>=#costs then
		prompt.ActionText="Island Complete!"
	else
		prompt.ActionText="Grow Island - "..costs[stage.Value+1].." Energy"
	end
end

local function spawnOrb()
	if not world.Parent then return end
	local orb=Instance.new("Part")
	orb.Name="EnergyOrb"
	orb.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball
	orb.Size=Vector3.new(2.2,2.2,2.2)
	orb.Material=Enum.Material.Neon
	orb.Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,220,80)
	orb.Anchored=true
	orb.CanCollide=false
	orb.Position=Vector3.new(math.random(-22,22),22,math.random(-22,22))
	orb.Parent=world
	local glow=Instance.new("PointLight")
	glow.Brightness=1
	glow.Range=8
	glow.Parent=orb
	local taken=false
	orb.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
		if taken then return end
		local character=hit.Parent
		local player=Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
		if not player then return end
		local stats=player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
		local energy=stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Energy")
		if not energy then return end
		taken=true
		energy.Value+=1
		orb:Destroy()
	end)
	task.delay(25,function()
		if orb.Parent then orb:Destroy() end
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	local stats=Instance.new("Folder")
	stats.Name="leaderstats"
	stats.Parent=player
	local energy=Instance.new("IntValue")
	energy.Name="Energy"
	energy.Parent=stats
	local stage=Instance.new("IntValue")
	stage.Name="IslandStage"
	stage.Parent=player

	local ok,data=pcall(function() return store:GetAsync("p_"..player.UserId) end)
	if ok and type(data)=="table" then
		energy.Value=tonumber(data.energy) or 0
		stage.Value=math.clamp(tonumber(data.stage) or 0,0,#costs)
	end
	for i=1,stage.Value do showStage(i) end
	refreshPrompt(player)
end)

local function save(player)
	local stats=player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local energy=stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Energy")
	local stage=player:FindFirstChild("IslandStage")
	if not energy or not stage then return end
	pcall(function()
		store:SetAsync("p_"..player.UserId,{energy=energy.Value,stage=stage.Value})
	end)
end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(save)
game:BindToClose(function()
	for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do save(p) end
end)

prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
	local stats=player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local energy=stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Energy")
	local stage=player:FindFirstChild("IslandStage")
	if not energy or not stage or stage.Value>=#costs then return end
	local cost=costs[stage.Value+1]
	if energy.Value<cost then return end
	energy.Value-=cost
	stage.Value+=1
	showStage(stage.Value)
	refreshPrompt(player)
end)

task.spawn(function()
	while world.Parent do
		local count=0
		for _,v in ipairs(world:GetChildren()) do
			if v.Name=="EnergyOrb" then count+=1 end
		end
		if count<18 then spawnOrb() end
		task.wait(1.1)
	end
end)

print("Grow the Island Build 1 loaded")
